title: Bias-Aware Transformer Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution lowercases and regex-tokenizes comments, builds a word vocabulary from training text only, maps rare or unseen words to UNK, pads and head-truncates sequences to 256 tokens, and length-buckets shuffled batches. A six-layer pre-layer-normalized Transformer encoder uses token and positional embeddings. Mean and masked-max pooling are concatenated for a GELU dense layer feeding a toxicity logit and sigmoid-trained identity auxiliary heads. Before supervised training, it performs masked-language-model pretraining on training comments: eligible tokens are selected with 15% probability and replaced by MASK, random tokens, or retained tokens; prediction uses an embedding-tied vocabulary-limited decoder. Fine-tuning minimizes bias-weighted toxicity BCE plus identity BCE on soft identity labels. Weights upweight identity-containing rows, non-identity positives, and identity negatives. AdamW, warmup-linear decay, mixed precision, and gradient clipping are used. Inference length-sorts examples and outputs sigmoid probabilities; epoch predictions are combined with exponentially increasing epoch weights.
